d: The former, Hunding Sieglinde suddenly goes up, listens and hears Hunding, who leads his horse outside to the stable. She hastily goes to the door and opens; Hunding, armed with shield and spear, enters and stops under the door as he is guarded by Siegmund. Hunding turns to Sieglinde with a seriously questioning look.

Siegmund, Siegmund, Siegmund alone. It has become complete night; the hall is lit only by a weak fire in the flock. Siegmund, close to the fire, settles down on the camp and, in great inner excitement, breeds silently for a while.

Sieglinde, Siegmund Having reached the mountain joch, Brünnhilde, looking down into the ravine, Siegmund and Sieglinde, looks at the nearers for a moment and then turns into the cave to her horse, so that it completely disappears to the spectator. - Siegmund and Sieglinde appear on the mountain joche. Sieglinde hastily steps ahead; Siegmund tries to stop them.

Brünnhilde, Siegmund Brünnhilde, guiding her horse at the bridle, steps out of the cave and steps slowly and solemnly forward. She stops and looks at Siegmund from afar. She walks slowly again. She stops in greater proximity. She carries shield and spear in one hand, leans with the other to the neck of the horse and looks at Siegmund with a serious face.
Wotan, Brünnhilde Wotan and Brünnhilde, who are still stretched at his feet, are left alone. Long, solemn silence: unchanged position
